name: API Binding
description: Pins a Site to an API contract family/version without storing endpoint credentials.
purpose: Allows a Site Manifest to pin one or more authoritative Phase 18 API groups to exact semantic versions and enabled Site environments.

fields.description: Environment IDs in which this binding applies.

relationships.description: apiId resolves against the authoritative Phase 18 API Contract Registry.
API bindings follow exact-version rules from the Phase 18 API Contract Standard.

validationRules.description: apiId and version must resolve to a compatible authoritative API group/version in the Phase 18 API Contract Registry.
API bindings declare compatibility only and must not contain tokens, passwords or private keys.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
